name: 1 · checkstyle.xml — one module per approved rule, hits on master (R37 §2)

items.title: SP22 / ADR-0017 S-6 ← CyclomaticComplexity
items.rule: Enable `CyclomaticComplexity` max **5**, `switchBlockAsSingleDecisionPoint` true; it fails the build for SP22 / ADR-0017 S-6.
items.extra: Legend: SF = spring-framework src/checkstyle/checkstyle.xml@b6fc3a1b6 · SB = spring-boot config/checkstyle/checkstyle.xml@22eef9729 · SJF = spring-javaformat spring-checkstyle.xml@4d3417e42 · GG/SUN = checkstyle google_checks.xml/sun_checks.xml · CSS = checkstyle config/checkstyle-checks.xml · KF = apache/kafka checkstyle.xml · CS/<m> = checkstyle.org module doc · AP = agent-platform origin/master@772736bf. Hits measured with Checkstyle 14.0.0 CLI on a git-archive copy (gated = modules Checkstyle runs on today; +ungated = aruvii-shared + aruvii-test-support). Full notes: research/59-checkstyle-and-smell-lists.md. | hits on master — gated **204** (114 files) · +ungated 11 · test 9

items.title: SP22 / DS9 ← NestedIfDepth
items.rule: Enable `NestedIfDepth` max **1** (3 levels fail); it fails the build for SP22 / DS9.

items.title: DS9 ← NestedForDepth
items.rule: Enable `NestedForDepth` max 1 · `NestedTryDepth` max 1; it fails the build for DS9.

items.title: JV9 ← NeedBraces
items.rule: Enable `NeedBraces` (default tokens); it fails the build for JV9.
items.extra: hits on master — gated **666** (178 files) · +ungated 39 · test 88

items.title: OQ2 / TY4 ← FinalLocalVariable
items.rule: Enable `FinalLocalVariable`, `validateEnhancedForLoopVariable` true; it fails the build for OQ2 / TY4.
items.recommend: error + baseline — TY4 forbids editing old lines only to add `final`, so a sweep is not allowed
items.extra: hits on master — gated **2612** (254 files) · +ungated 33 · test 3397 (ST1)

items.title: X6 / SP23 ← IllegalImport
items.rule: Enable `IllegalImport` `jakarta/javax.annotation.PostConstruct` + regex for FQ use; it fails the build for X6 / SP23.
items.recommend: error + baseline the 5 until agent-platform #663 (the @PostConstruct/@Autowired rewrite) lands

items.title: SC1 ← IllegalImport
items.rule: Enable `IllegalImport` `…annotation.Autowired` + `RegexpSinglelineJava` `@org.springframework…Autowired`; it fails the build for SC1.
items.recommend: error + baseline until #663; main config only. The 2 FQ uses (`ToolService.java:153`, `ChatOrchestrator.java:128`) pass `IllegalImport` — the regex is required
items.extra: hits on master — gated 8 import + **2 FQ** · +ungated 1 (test-support, allowed by SC1) · test 81 (allowed)

items.title: existing ← UnusedImports
items.rule: Enable `UnusedImports`; it fails the build for existing.
items.recommend: keep (catches the ungated hit once D3 lands)

items.title: new CK1 (SF-C:363) ← LineLength
items.rule: Enable `LineLength` max **120**; it fails the build for new CK1 (SF-C:363).
items.recommend: error + file baseline (D5). Master's own header says "LineLength — enforced by IDE config" (`checkstyle.xml:20`); 269 lines say it is not
items.extra: hits on master — gated **186** (71 files) · +ungated 83 · test 258

items.title: DS2 ← FileLength
items.rule: Enable `FileLength` max 1000; it fails the build for DS2.
items.recommend: error + one suppression with DS2's stated reason, or the split

items.title: FW1 (pending) ← ParameterNumber

items.recommend: error + baseline *if* FW1 is approved (R36 D1 = 7)

items.title: new CK4 (Fowler Long Parameter List; Sonar S107 default 7) ← ParameterNumber

items.title: ER3 / ER8 ← EmptyCatchBlock
items.rule: Enable `EmptyCatchBlock` `commentFormat="(?!)"` (no comment excuses it); it fails the build for ER3 / ER8.
items.recommend: error + baseline (D8). With the default (a comment excuses it): 8

items.title: ER4 ("never Throwable") ← IllegalCatch
items.rule: Enable `IllegalCatch` `Throwable, Error`; it fails the build for ER4 ("never `Throwable`").
items.recommend: error now (main). `catch (Exception)` stays review — ER4 allows it at a commented boundary; would be 300 hits

items.title: JV6 ← IllegalType
items.rule: Enable `IllegalType` `Optional` on `PARAMETER_DEF, RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF`, and fields (`VARIABLE_DEF` + `memberModifiers`); it fails the build for JV6.
items.extra: hits on master — gated 2 + 0 fields · +ungated 1 · test 2

items.title: JV2 ← RegexpSinglelineJava
items.rule: Enable `RegexpSinglelineJava` `.parallelStream()` / `.parallel()`; it fails the build for JV2.

items.title: SP19 (R36) ← RegexpSinglelineJava
items.rule: Enable `RegexpSinglelineJava` `System.(out|err).print`, `.printStackTrace()`; it fails the build for SP19 (R36).

items.title: SP18 (R36) ← HideUtilityClassConstructor
items.rule: Enable `HideUtilityClassConstructor` `ignoreAnnotatedBy=SpringBootApplication` · `FinalClass`; it fails the build for SP18 (R36).

items.title: LG6 (single-line form only) ← RegexpSinglelineJava
items.rule: Enable `RegexpSinglelineJava` `log.x("…" +`; it fails the build for LG6 (single-line form only).
items.recommend: error now; multi-line concatenation stays review

items.title: new CK5 ← UnusedLocalVariable
items.rule: Enable `UnusedLocalVariable`; it fails the build for new CK5.
items.recommend: error + baseline; most are `ignored` names that Java 22+ writes as `_`

items.title: new CK3 ← BooleanExpressionComplexity
items.rule: Enable `BooleanExpressionComplexity` max 3 (default); it fails the build for new CK3.

items.title: new CK2 (SF:41,50,64-69; SJF:39,45,50-56) ← EqualsHashCode
items.rule: Enable `EqualsHashCode`, `CovariantEquals`, `StringLiteralEquality`, `SimplifyBooleanExpression`, `SimplifyBooleanReturn`, `EmptyStatement`, `InnerAssignment`, `AvoidNestedBlocks`, `MutableException`; it fails the build for new CK2 (SF:41,50,64-69; SJF:39,45,50-56).

items.title: new CK2 (SF:79,92; GG:184,187) ← OneStatementPerLine
items.rule: Enable `OneStatementPerLine` · `MultipleVariableDeclarations`; it fails the build for new CK2 (SF:79,92; GG:184,187).

items.title: How old violations are tolerated
items.rule: a) xpath baseline (`-g`) + file suppressions (`-G`) — tested: 3803 + 196 entries · b) `severity=warning` + Gradle `maxWarnings` per task · c) fix all first (≈4000 main hits)
items.extra: what changes: a: new code gated from day one, file shrinks · b: one count per module, a new hit can replace a fixed one · c: blocks every gate on a sweep TY4 forbids for `final`

items.title: SP22 limit (S-6 says "complexity 5 or less")
items.rule: a) 5, switch counts once — 204 gated · b) 5, each case counts — 261 (all main) · c) 10 (Checkstyle/Sonar default) — 43 gated
items.recommend: **a)** + baseline; CS/cyclomaticcomplexity calls 5-7 "OK", so 5 is strict but legal
items.extra: what changes: a keeps S-6 as written and does not punish S-4's exhaustive switches; c rewrites S-6

items.extra: what changes: a adds 162+22 files: +83 LineLength, +39 NeedBraces, +33 final, +11 complexity (all baselined)
